drills.name: Ground Ball Fundamentals
drills.description: Coach rolls firm grounders, alternating forehand and backhand. Field, footwork, throw to the bucket target.
drills.coachingPoints: Fielding triangle: feet wide, glove out front. Right, left, throw. Work through the ball, never around it.

drills.name: Tee Work: Bat Path
drills.description: Hitters rotate through tee stations into a net: middle tee, inside tee moved up, outside tee moved back. Five swings per station.
drills.coachingPoints: Short to the ball, long through it. Match the tee depth to the pitch location.

drills.name: Front Toss Rhythm Rounds
drills.description: Coach front-tosses from behind an L-screen at game-like rhythm, mixing speeds slightly. Hitters take rounds of six, calling ball or strike before swinging.
drills.coachingPoints: See it early, load on time. Let your eyes decide before your hands do.

drills.name: Opposite-Field Rounds
drills.description: Front toss on the outer half only. Hitters get a round of six and every ball must go to the opposite-field side of second base or the round doesn't count.
drills.coachingPoints: Let the outside pitch travel deep and drive it where it's pitched.

drills.name: Two-Strike Battle
drills.description: Every at-bat starts 1-2. Coach mixes locations and takes; hitter earns a point for any ball put in play, loses one for a called strike three or chase.
drills.coachingPoints: Choke up, widen out, shorten the swing. Win the pitch, not the highlight.

drills.name: First-Step Reads off the Bat
drills.description: Fielders at their positions; coach hits live fungos in any direction. Players read contact and take only their first three steps at full speed, then reset.
drills.coachingPoints: Read the angle of the bat, not the flight of the ball. Your first step decides the play.

drills.name: Pop-Up Priority
drills.description: Coach lofts pop-ups into the seams between infielders and outfielders. Players call it by priority rules, everyone else peels off loudly.
drills.coachingPoints: Call it three times, early and loud. The outfielder coming in owns the seam.

drills.name: Four-Corner Quick Throws
drills.description: Four lines form a square 60 feet apart. Ball moves around the horn with quick transfers; on the whistle, reverse direction. Race two squares against each other.
drills.coachingPoints: Catch moving toward your target. Glove to pocket in one motion.

drills.name: Long Toss Ladder
drills.description: Pairs start at 60 feet and back up ten feet after every five clean throws, out to each player's max distance, then walk it back in with firm low throws.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay tall and finish out front. Stretch the distance, never the mechanics.

drills.name: Bullpen Command Grid
drills.description: Catcher splits the zone into four quadrants; pitcher throws a 20-pitch pen calling the quadrant before each pitch. Score a point per hit target.
drills.coachingPoints: Commit to the quadrant before you lift your leg. Aim small, miss small.

drills.name: Dry Mechanics Mirror
drills.description: Pitchers pair up without a ball and work delivery checkpoints: balance point, hand break, stride, finish. The partner freezes them at each one to check positions.
drills.coachingPoints: Pause at the balance point in full control. If you can't hold it, you rushed it.

drills.name: Pickoffs vs Live Leads
drills.description: Pitcher works from the stretch with a live runner at first taking real leads. Pitcher mixes pitches home, holds, and pickoff throws; runner works reads and dives back.
drills.coachingPoints: Vary your looks and your timing. The pattern is what runners steal, not the pitch.

drills.name: Steal Jumps off the Pitcher
drills.description: Runners at first read a pitcher's live moves: break on first movement home, dive back on a pickoff. Three reads each, rotate runners through.
drills.coachingPoints: Read the heel and the front shoulder. Cross over and go, no false step.

drills.name: First-to-Third Reads
drills.description: Runner at first, coach fungos base hits to different outfield spots. Runner reads the ball's angle rounding second and decides to take third or hold, with a base coach signaling.
drills.coachingPoints: Pick up the ball at the cut of second and find your coach. Decide early, run hard through the decision.

drills.name: Sliding Technique Station
drills.description: On grass or a sliding mat, players run at three-quarter speed and work bent-leg slides into a loose base, progressing to slides to either side of the bag.
drills.coachingPoints: Sit, don't jump. Hands up, slide past the tag side of the base.

drills.name: Home-to-First Sprints
drills.description: Full-speed swings off an imaginary pitch, then sprint through first base on a timer. Two rounds: straight through on a single, banana turn on a double.
drills.coachingPoints: Run through the base at full speed and hit the front half of the bag.

drills.name: Base Path Agility Relays
drills.description: Two teams race a cone circuit shaped like the base paths: sprint, round the cone tight, shuffle a segment, backpedal home, tag the next runner.
drills.coachingPoints: Lean into every turn and cut the corner tight. Wide turns lose the race.

drills.name: Cutoffs and Relays
drills.description: Coach fungos balls to the outfield gaps with a called play; outfielder hits the cutoff man, who relays to the called base. Rotate outfield, cutoff, and base positions.
drills.coachingPoints: Line up the relay with your hands up and call the base. Two low, hard throws beat one rainbow.

drills.name: Freeze Situations
drills.description: Full defense on the field. Coach calls outs and runners, fungos a live ball, and yells freeze after the play. Every player explains where they went and why.
drills.coachingPoints: Know your job before the pitch. The play is decided before the ball is hit.

drills.name: Bunt Defense Reps
drills.description: Infield aligns in bunt coverage with runners on; coach rolls or bunts live balls and the defense executes the called play to first, second, or third.
drills.coachingPoints: Charge under control, field with two hands, and listen for the base call before you throw.

drills.name: High Tee, Low Tee Ladder
drills.description: Two tees per station, one set belt high and one set at the bottom of the zone. Hitter alternates five swings at each height without resetting his stance.
drills.coachingPoints: Same swing, different plane. Turn the barrel to the ball, don't lift it.

drills.name: One-Hand Tee Rounds
drills.description: Hitter chokes up and takes five top-hand-only swings off a tee into a net, then five bottom-hand-only, then five with both hands. Keep the back elbow tight on the top-hand set.
drills.coachingPoints: Top hand turns the barrel. Bottom hand pulls the knob. Slow it down until it feels connected.

drills.name: Side Toss Angles
drills.description: Feeder kneels at a 45 degree angle in front of the hitter and tosses into the middle of the zone, then moves to a flatter angle for the outer half. Six swings from each spot.
drills.coachingPoints: Let the ball get to you from the flat angle. Barrel stays in the zone a long time.

drills.name: Walk-Through Front Toss
drills.description: Hitter starts two steps behind the plate and walks slowly toward the pitcher, striding into the ball when the coach front-tosses from behind an L-screen. Rounds of six.
drills.coachingPoints: Land on time, then hit. If you are late, the ball tells you before I do.

drills.name: Number Ball Recognition
drills.description: Write a number on one side of each ball. Coach front-tosses and the hitter calls the number out loud before deciding to swing or take, swinging only on odd numbers.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes on the ball out of the hand, not on the strike zone. See it, then decide.

drills.name: Take and Track Rounds
drills.description: First three pitches of every round are takes. Hitter loads and strides on every one but does not swing, then swings freely on the next five.
drills.coachingPoints: Track it all the way into the mitt. Your body should still be on time on a take.

drills.name: Gap-to-Gap Tee Rounds
drills.description: Three tee positions: inside and out front, middle, outside and deep. Hitter takes four swings at each and has to drive the ball toward the matching gap.
drills.coachingPoints: Contact point moves, the swing does not. Pull the inside one, let the outside one travel.

drills.name: Situational Live BP
drills.description: Coach calls a situation before each round: runner on second nobody out, runner on third one out, leadoff at-bat. Hitter gets four swings and the round only scores if the at-bat does its job.
drills.coachingPoints: The situation picks the swing. Move the runner first, hit the ball hard second.

drills.name: Hit-and-Run Ground Balls
drills.description: Front toss with a runner on first breaking on the pitch. Hitter must put the ball on the ground to the right side no matter where it is pitched, five attempts each.
drills.coachingPoints: Swing down through the top half. Protect the runner, take the single you get.

drills.name: Short Bat Two-Strike Rounds
drills.description: Hitters use a shorter, lighter bat or choke up two inches, widen the stance, and take a full round of eight front-toss pitches with the two-strike swing only.
drills.coachingPoints: Choke up, widen out, shorten up. Put the barrel on it and live to see another pitch.

drills.name: Foul-Off Survival Game
drills.description: Every at-bat starts with two strikes and the hitter stays up until he swings and misses or takes a strike. Fouls keep the at-bat alive and a ball in play ends it as a win.
drills.coachingPoints: Anything close, you hit it. Battle the pitch, not the scoreboard.

drills.name: Sacrifice Bunt Rotation
drills.description: Three stations: pivot and square with no ball, bunt tossed balls into a cone target down each line, then live bunts off a coach throwing from short distance. Rotate after four minutes.
drills.coachingPoints: Get the barrel out early and let the ball hit the bat. Deaden it, don't stab at it.

drills.name: Knees Hands Routine
drills.description: Fielders work in pairs on both knees about fifteen feet apart, rolling firm balls at each other. No legs allowed, so the glove and the hands do all the work.
drills.coachingPoints: Glove out front, fingers to the dirt. Funnel it to the middle of your chest.

drills.name: Wide Base Rolled Balls
drills.description: Same partner rolls from fifteen feet, but the fielder stands with feet wider than the shoulders and stays planted. Bend at the knees, field ten, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Sit down into it, don't bend at the waist. Eyes stay level with the ball.

drills.name: Right, Left, Throw Footwork Rolls
drills.description: Partner rolls a ball and the fielder works the right-left-field, right-left-throw rhythm through the catch and into a throw back. Ten reps, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Field it moving forward. The feet set up the throw before you catch it.

drills.name: Partner Short Hops
drills.description: Partners kneel or stand ten feet apart and throw deliberate short hops at each other, alternating straight on, forehand side, and backhand side. Fifteen each.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack the hop, never wait on it. Soft hands beat quick hands here.

drills.name: Backhand and Forehand Rolls
drills.description: Coach or partner rolls balls two steps to each side. Fielder works the backhand set with the right foot down, then the forehand with the glove-side foot leading. Eight each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Backhand: get the right foot past the ball. Forehand: don't reach across your body.

drills.name: Circle Drill Fungo
drills.description: Draw a circle in the dirt in front of each infielder. Players who sit back on the ball start behind the circle and must field inside it. Players who get flat-footed start inside and must move out through the ball.
drills.coachingPoints: Fix your own habit. Either get to it or get through it, not both feet planted.

drills.name: Short-Distance Fungo
drills.description: Coach hits fungos from halfway between home and each position at a softer pace. Fielders work their pre-pitch move, hop read, and approach without having to rush the throw.
drills.coachingPoints: Move before the ball is hit. Pick your hop, then go get it.

drills.name: Slow Roller Charge and Barehand
drills.description: Coach rolls a dying ball up the third base line. Fielder charges hard, fields with the glove on the first two reps and barehand on the third, and throws on the run to first.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint to it, then slow your hands. Field it off your left foot and throw through the target.

drills.name: Double Play Feeds and Pivots
drills.description: Middle infielders alternate feeding and turning off rolled balls at three distances: underhand flip range, short overhand, and a full pivot from the hole. Five turns each before switching.
drills.coachingPoints: Show the ball early on the feed. Get to the bag under control, then let the feet take you across.

drills.name: Drop-Step Fly Ball Reads
drills.description: Outfielders line up facing the coach, who points left or right and throws a ball over that shoulder. Player drop-steps, turns, and runs it down without backpedaling.
drills.coachingPoints: Open the hips, never backpedal. Turn and run, then find the ball.

drills.name: Do-or-Die Outfield Charges
drills.description: Coach rolls a ball into the outfield gap with a runner tagging from third. Outfielder charges, fields on the glove side while moving, and crow hops through the throw home.
drills.coachingPoints: Field it off the glove-side foot so your momentum carries you. Low throw through the cutoff, not a rainbow.

drills.name: Crossover Reads on the Line Drive
drills.description: Infielders start in their ready position and the coach fires a ball firmly to one side from thirty feet. Only the first two steps count, then freeze and reset.
drills.coachingPoints: Crossover, don't shuffle. Your first step is either right or it's a hit.

drills.name: Sun Ball Pop-Ups
drills.description: Coach hits high fungos into the afternoon sun toward the corner outfield spots. Fielders learn to shield with the glove hand and drift rather than camp underneath it.
drills.coachingPoints: Glove up beside the ball, not under it. Move your feet to find an angle out of the glare.

drills.name: Infield Pop-Up Priority Calls
drills.description: Coach fungos short pop-ups into the triangle between the mound, first, and second. Whoever calls it three times loud and early takes it and everyone else peels off and echoes the call.
drills.coachingPoints: Call it loud, call it early, call it three times. Everyone else says his name back.

drills.name: Balance and Break Holds
drills.description: Pitcher lifts the front leg to the top of the delivery and holds three seconds, then breaks the hands and holds again at separation. Six reps dry, then six into a partner at short distance.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay tall and quiet at the top. Hands break down, back, and up together.

drills.name: Wall Drill Front-Side
drills.description: Pitcher stands a forearm's length from a fence or wall with the glove side facing it, then rides down the mound line so the front hip and glove arrive without the shoulder flying open. Eight dry reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Lead with the hip, hold the glove over the front foot. Don't let the shoulder beat the hip.

drills.name: One-Knee Arm Path Throws
drills.description: Pitcher kneels on the back knee with the front leg open, and throws to a partner at forty feet using only the upper half. Fifteen throws, focusing on a clean path from separation to release.
drills.coachingPoints: Thumb down, fingers behind the ball. Finish out front, don't cut it off.

drills.name: Rocker Step Progression
drills.description: Start from a feet-split rocker position and throw ten, then add the leg lift for ten, then the full windup for ten. Same target, same intent, each step built on the last.
drills.coachingPoints: Nothing changes but the start. If the ball moves off target, back up a step.

drills.name: Flat Ground Command Targets
drills.description: Pitchers throw twenty on flat ground to a partner holding a glove in a fixed spot, five each to glove side low, arm side low, and both sides at the belt. No max effort.
drills.coachingPoints: Seventy-five percent effort, one hundred percent target. Miss down, never up.

drills.name: Fastball Down-and-Away Ladder
drills.description: Set a cone just off the outside corner. Pitcher throws three at the knees, three at the belt, three back at the knees, and has to hit the outer third every time or the set starts over.
drills.coachingPoints: Aim small, miss small. Ride the front side through the target.

drills.name: Corner Count Game
drills.description: Catcher calls out a count before each pitch and sets up on a corner. Pitcher earns a point for hitting the spot and loses one for a pitch over the middle. Fifteen pitches per turn.
drills.coachingPoints: A 2-0 strike still has to have a location. Middle-middle is the only real mistake.

drills.name: Change-Up Feel Catch Play
drills.description: During normal catch play at forty-five feet, pitchers throw every third ball as a change-up with the same arm speed as the fastball. Twenty total throws mixed in.
drills.coachingPoints: Same arm speed, looser grip. Let the grip take the speed off, not your arm.

drills.name: Two-Pitch Sequencing Pen
drills.description: A twenty-pitch bullpen where the pitcher has to call the sequence out loud before each pair: fastball in then change away, fastball up then change down. Catcher grades whether the pair worked together.
drills.coachingPoints: Set one pitch up with the one before it. Sequence beats stuff at this age.

drills.name: Hitter's Eye Pitch Mix
drills.description: A live hitter stands in and takes every pitch while the pitcher works a full mix. The hitter calls the pitch type out loud after each one and the pitcher tracks how often he is read.
drills.coachingPoints: If he names it every time, your arm speed is giving it away. Same delivery, every pitch.

drills.name: Slide Step and Hold Times
drills.description: From the stretch, pitcher alternates a full leg lift, a slide step, and a long hold on the rubber. A coach times from first move to the catcher's glove and calls it out.
drills.coachingPoints: Under one-point-three to the plate or he is stealing on you. Vary the hold so he can't time it.

drills.name: Pickoff Reads at First
drills.description: Pitcher works from the stretch with a live runner taking a lead. A coach behind the mound signals throw or pitch after the set, so the pitcher has to react rather than decide early.
drills.coachingPoints: Same set every time. Quick feet, short throw, let the first baseman apply the tag.

drills.name: Inside Move to Second
drills.description: Middle infielders run a daylight or count play behind a runner at second while the pitcher works the inside turn. Run it eight times with the shortstop and second baseman alternating the break.
drills.coachingPoints: Turn on the inside, not the outside. Infielder breaks on his own, the pitcher just reads daylight.

drills.name: Wrist Flip Warm-Up
drills.description: Partners kneel ten feet apart on the throwing-side knee and flip the ball with the wrist only, elbow held up and still. Twenty flips before any full throws.
drills.coachingPoints: Fingers behind the ball, thumb down underneath. Snap it, don't push it.

drills.name: Figure-Eight Arm Path
drills.description: From a standing throwing position, players trace a figure eight with the throwing hand out of the glove, then release into a partner at thirty feet on the last loop. Fifteen reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Down, back, and up in one piece. If the hand stops, start the loop over.

drills.name: Arm Care Band Series
drills.description: Before throwing, players work a five-exercise band series anchored to a fence: external rotation, internal rotation, pull-aparts, scaption raises, and a reverse throw. Ten controlled reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Slow and controlled, no bouncing. This is maintenance, not a workout.

drills.name: Bucket Target Throws
drills.description: Set a bucket on its side at each base. Players throw from their position and score a point for hitting the bucket and a half point for a one-hop that reaches it. Ten throws each.
drills.coachingPoints: Throw to the chest, not to the glove. A firm one-hop beats a throw over his head.

drills.name: Knee-High Throw Game
drills.description: Partners at sixty feet. Every throw has to arrive between the receiver's knees and chest without a step to either side. Three misses in a row and the pair moves five feet closer.
drills.coachingPoints: Line, not arc. Point the front shoulder where you want it to go.

drills.name: Relay Line Accuracy Race
drills.description: Two lines of four players spread across the outfield. Ball travels down and back through every set of hands and any throw that pulls a teammate off the bag sends the ball back to the start.
drills.coachingPoints: Chest-high to the glove side so he can turn. Hands up early as a target.

drills.name: Quick Transfer Ladder
drills.description: Partner rolls or tosses a ball and the fielder has to catch, transfer, and release inside a count of two. Ten reps standing, ten on the move, ten off a short hop.
drills.coachingPoints: Transfer in the middle of your chest, not out by the glove. Quick feet, quick hands, normal throw.

drills.name: Crow Hop to the Cutoff
drills.description: Outfielders field a rolled ball, crow hop, and throw to a cutoff man standing at the edge of the infield dirt. Eight reps each, alternating throws to second and to home.
drills.coachingPoints: Gather behind the ball so the hop goes forward. Throw through the cutoff's head, not to it.

drills.name: Catcher Pop Time Throws
drills.description: Catchers receive a front-tossed ball in the crouch and throw to second on a coach's timer. Five reps from a no-runner setup, then five with a runner actually stealing.
drills.coachingPoints: Feet under you as the ball arrives. Transfer to the ear and throw, don't wind up.

drills.name: Long Toss Pull-Down Finish
drills.description: After a normal long toss stretch out, partners walk back in and throw ten hard, flat throws on a line from progressively shorter distances. Stop the second anyone's arm feels tired.
drills.coachingPoints: Line drive throws coming back in, not lobs. Stop before you are sore, not after.

drills.name: Arc to Line Long Toss
drills.description: Partners stretch out to their comfortable distance letting the ball arc, then hold that distance and try to flatten each throw into a line drive. Six arcing, six flattening.
drills.coachingPoints: Let it climb on the way out, drive it flat on the way back. Distance is earned, not forced.

drills.name: Primary and Secondary Lead Reps
drills.description: Runners take a three-shuffle primary lead off a throw-down base, then two hard secondary shuffles as the coach simulates the pitch crossing the plate. Ten reps with a return on every third one.
drills.coachingPoints: Secondary lands as the ball hits the mitt. Right foot down, weight forward, never on your heels.

drills.name: Read the Dirt Ball
drills.description: Coach front-tosses to a catcher and randomly bounces one in the dirt. Runner at first or third reads it off the bat of the plate and breaks only when the ball hits the ground in front.
drills.coachingPoints: Read the angle down, not the catcher. Break on the bounce, not on the block.

drills.name: Freeze on the Line Drive
drills.description: Runner takes a secondary lead while a coach fungos either a ground ball, a fly ball, or a line drive. Runner has to freeze on the liner, go on the grounder, and read the fly.
drills.coachingPoints: Line drive, you freeze. Ground ball, you go. If you guess, you get doubled off.

drills.name: Tag-Up Reads from Third
drills.description: Runner at third tags on fly balls hit to left, center, and right. Coach calls go or hold after the catch based on the outfielder's arm and momentum. Six reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Left foot on the bag, eyes on the catch. Go on the catch, not on the flight.

drills.name: Rounding First Base
drills.description: Runners start with a swing, run the first half of the lane straight, then bank out and touch the inside corner of the bag looking into right field. Six reps, three straight through and three with a turn.
drills.coachingPoints: Bank out at the halfway point, don't curve the whole way. Peek at the ball once you round it.

drills.name: First-to-Third Aggression Game
drills.description: Runner on first, coach hits a single to an outfielder who has to make the throw. Runner scores a point for making third safely and loses two for being thrown out, so the read has to be real.
drills.coachingPoints: Pick the ball up at the shortstop, not over your shoulder. Decide by the time you hit second.

drills.name: Double Off the Wall Reads
drills.description: Coach rolls a ball into the outfield corner while the runner leaves the box. Runner has to pick up the third base coach after rounding first and commit to two or three bases without slowing down.
drills.coachingPoints: Find your coach before you reach second. Never slow down to look at the ball.

drills.name: Bent-Leg Slide Progression
drills.description: On a sliding mat or wet grass in socks, players start from a walk and build to a jog: sit into the figure four, then add a two-step approach, then a full slide into a throw-down base.
drills.coachingPoints: Sit down, don't dive down. Hands up and back, never plant a hand to brake.

drills.name: Pop-Up Slide and Advance
drills.description: From a bent-leg slide, the runner drives off the lead foot and comes straight up onto the bag looking for an overthrow. Eight reps with a coach randomly throwing one past the base.
drills.coachingPoints: Let the momentum stand you up. Eyes find the ball the second you are on the bag.

drills.name: Dive Back to the Bag
drills.description: Runner takes a primary lead and dives back to first on the pitcher's move, reaching with the near hand to the back corner of the bag. Six reps, alternating a dive back and a full retreat step.
drills.coachingPoints: Near hand to the back corner, chin up. Never reach across your body into the tag.

drills.name: Steal Break Timing Game
drills.description: Pitcher works from the stretch with varied hold times while a coach times the runner from first move to the bag. Runners get three attempts and keep their best time.
drills.coachingPoints: Cross over, don't hop. First three steps win the bag, the rest is just running.

drills.name: Delayed Steal Reads
drills.description: Runner at first takes a normal secondary lead and breaks for second only if the middle infielders both drift away from the bag after the catch. Run it eight times with the defense unaware which reps are live.
drills.coachingPoints: Watch the middle infielders, not the catcher. If nobody covers, you already won.

drills.name: Acceleration Starts from the Box
drills.description: Runners start in their finished-swing position and sprint fifteen yards on the coach's clap. Six reps with full walk-back rest between each.
drills.coachingPoints: First three steps low and hard. Drive the back arm, don't stand straight up.

drills.name: Flying 20s Down the Line
drills.description: Players jog a fifteen yard build-up zone, then sprint an all-out twenty yard zone marked by cones, then decelerate for fifteen. Four reps with sixty seconds between.
drills.coachingPoints: Hit the second cone already at full speed. Relax the face and the hands.

drills.name: Home-to-Second Timed Runs
drills.description: Players run home to second on a stopwatch with a proper turn at first, twice each, resting a full minute between. Post the times and re-run the drill later in the season.
drills.coachingPoints: The turn is where the time is, not the straightaway. Hit the inside corner of the bag.

drills.name: Sprint Ladder to the Bases
drills.description: From home, players sprint to first and back, then to second and back, then to third and back. One full ladder per player with a two-minute rest, repeated twice.
drills.coachingPoints: Touch the bag, don't slow down for it. Same effort on the last leg as the first.

drills.name: Lateral Shuffle Cone Grid
drills.description: Five cones in a line five feet apart. Players shuffle down and back staying square, then repeat leading with a crossover step. Three trips each way.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay low, don't click the heels together. Chest over the toes the whole trip.

drills.name: Pro Agility Shuttle
drills.description: Three cones five yards apart. Player starts in the middle, sprints five yards right, ten yards left, then five back through the middle. Four reps with full rest.
drills.coachingPoints: Drop the hips before you change direction. Touch the line with the inside hand.

drills.name: Mirror Shuffle Reactions
drills.description: Partners face each other five feet apart. One leads with random lateral shuffles and short bursts forward and back, the other mirrors him. Thirty seconds on, thirty off, three rounds each.
drills.coachingPoints: React, don't anticipate. Feet never stop, eyes on his hips.

drills.name: Bodyweight Strength Circuit
drills.description: Four stations run for forty seconds each with twenty seconds to rotate: push-ups, bodyweight squats, split squats, and glute bridges. Two full rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Clean reps beat fast reps. Stop the set when the form goes, not when the clock does.

drills.name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throws
drills.description: Players stand side-on to a fence or wall and throw a light medicine ball with a hitting-style rotation, six each side, then six overhead scoop throws. Use the lightest ball that still feels like work.
drills.coachingPoints: Turn from the ground up, hips first. Throw it hard, catch it soft.

drills.name: Plank and Bridge Series
drills.description: Front plank, both side planks, and a glute bridge hold, thirty seconds each with fifteen seconds between. Two rounds through the series.
drills.coachingPoints: Straight line from ear to ankle. Squeeze the belly, don't sag the hips.

drills.name: Band Pull and Row Series
drills.description: Bands anchored on a fence at chest height. Players work pull-aparts, single-arm rows, and face pulls for twelve reps each, two rounds, focused on the back and the shoulder blade.
drills.coachingPoints: Pull with the shoulder blades, not the hands. Slow on the way back every rep.

drills.name: Foul Pole Tempo Intervals
drills.description: Players run foul pole to foul pole at about seventy percent effort, walk the width of the outfield to recover, and repeat. Four to six trips depending on the age group.
drills.coachingPoints: Tempo, not a race. If you can't talk in short sentences, back off.

drills.name: Position Circuit Endurance
drills.description: Four stations around the field: sprint to a cone and back, ten quick jump-and-stick landings, twenty second lateral shuffle, and a base path jog. Forty-five seconds per station, three rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Move through the whole round, no standing between stations. Land soft on every jump.

drills.name: PFP: Comebackers and Covers
drills.description: Pitchers rotate through three looks off a coach's fungo: a comebacker to a set infielder, a ground ball to the right side with the pitcher covering first, and a bunt up the line. Six reps of each look.
drills.coachingPoints: Run to a spot near the bag, then look for the ball. Catch it before you find the base.

drills.name: First-and-Third Defense
drills.description: Runners at first and third with a live break to second. Defense rotates through three calls: throw through, cut and look, and a fake throw back to the pitcher. Six reps of each.
drills.coachingPoints: The call comes before the pitch, out loud. Nobody freelances with a runner at third.

drills.name: Rundown Mechanics
drills.description: Two fielders and a runner between two bases. Fielders run the ball hard at the runner to force a commit, use one throw, and the tagger follows his throw to the back of the line. Ten rundowns per group.
drills.coachingPoints: Run him hard, one throw, tag him. Ball up by the ear the whole time.

drills.name: Rundown Escape Reps
drills.description: Same rundown setup from the runner's side. Runner tries to stay alive long enough for a trail runner to advance, changing direction only when a fielder commits to a throw.
drills.coachingPoints: Make them throw it. Every extra second is a base for the guy behind you.

drills.name: Bunt Defense: Wheel and Hold
drills.description: Runner at first, coach bunts from the plate. Defense runs the hold play once, then the wheel with the shortstop covering third, alternating on the coach's pre-pitch call. Eight reps of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Corners charge on the wheel, nobody peeks. Catcher owns the call on where it goes.

drills.name: Squeeze Defense Reads
drills.description: Runner at third, coach shows bunt late. Pitcher throws the pitchout or the pitch up and in, catcher comes out to field and tag, and the corners crash. Run it ten times with the timing varied.
drills.coachingPoints: Pitch it up and in where it can't be bunted down. Catcher fields it and tags, no throw.

drills.name: Third Base Charge Reads
drills.description: Third baseman reads sacrifice bunt versus fake bunt and slash. Coach either bunts it down the line or pulls back and swings, so the fielder has to hold ground until the bat commits.
drills.coachingPoints: Creep, don't sprint, until the bat is down. If he pulls it back, you are already dead standing still.

drills.name: Relay Reads from the Corner
drills.description: Ball hit into the corner with a runner going first to home. Outfielder plays the carom, the middle infielder lines up between the ball and the base, and the trail man calls the target. Eight reps each corner.
drills.coachingPoints: Cutoff man gets out there and shows his hands. The trail man calls three, four, or home.

drills.name: Two-Cut Deep Gap Relay
drills.description: Ball rolls to the deepest part of the gap. Two relay men line up in tandem so the outfielder has a short throw and the second man can redirect. Run it six times to each gap.
drills.coachingPoints: Line up in a straight line to the base, both of you. Second man is the safety valve, not a decoration.

drills.name: Infield In, Infield Back
drills.description: Coach calls a score and an inning, then fungos a ground ball. Infielders have to be set at the right depth before the pitch and make the right play for the situation. Twelve reps mixing both depths.
drills.coachingPoints: Depth is decided before the pitch, not after the hop. Know the run that matters.

drills.name: Situations Scrimmage
drills.description: Live half-inning scrimmage where the coach sets the score, inning, outs, and runners before every at-bat. Play it out, then stop and ask two players what they were thinking before the pitch.
drills.coachingPoints: Know the situation before the pitch, every pitch. Say your job out loud to the guy next to you.

drills.name: Bunt for a Hit Reads
drills.description: Hitter reads the corner infielders' depth before squaring late, drag bunting toward first when the third baseman plays back and pushing it past the pitcher when he crashes. Five attempts each way.
drills.coachingPoints: Look at the corners, then decide. Move your feet last so you don't tip it early.

drills.name: Squeeze Bunt Execution
drills.description: Runner at third breaks on the pitch and the hitter has to get the bunt down on the ground no matter where the pitch is, including one deliberately thrown high and one inside. Six attempts each.
drills.coachingPoints: Bunt it down, anywhere fair. Reach for a bad one, you never pull the bat back with him running.

drills.name: Foul Territory Pop-Up Calls
drills.description: Coach fungos pop-ups into foul ground near the dugout and down each line. Catcher and the corner infielder both go, and whoever has the better angle calls it while the other peels off and spots the fence.
drills.coachingPoints: Catcher turns his back to the infield and lets it drift to him. Corner man calls him off only if he is clearly there first.

drills.name: Throwing Progression Ladder
drills.description: Standard pre-practice throwing build-up: fifteen throws at thirty feet, fifteen at forty-five, fifteen at sixty, then back in. Nobody throws at full effort until the third distance.
drills.coachingPoints: Build up, don't warm up by throwing hard. Every throw on a line to the chest.
